outcome: Give CPG teams a working Revenue Growth Management — Price & Pack Optimization capability on their own data — it protects and grows margin through data-led pricing.
overview: Inflation and private-label pressure have made price and pack architecture the strongest profit lever available to CPG businesses across the Gulf, yet the decisions are still argued from spreadsheets nobody entirely trusts. Revenue Growth Management — Price & Pack Optimization models own- and cross-price elasticity and portfolio mix across price history, volumes, competitor pricing, cost and pack data, then lets commercial teams simulate price points, pack sizes and channel-specific pricing before committing to any of them. No price moves automatically; the output is a defensible fact base for internal sign-off and retailer negotiation. Redington fixes the margin and price-realisation baselines up front and delivers the working simulator in four to five weeks.
